0:
model_list:
  - model_name: "claude-opus-4.7"
    litellm_params:
      model: "github_copilot/claude-opus-4.7"
  - model_name: "claude-opus-4.6"
    litellm_params:
      model: "github_copilot/claude-opus-4.6"
  - model_name: "claude-sonnet-4.6"
    litellm_params:
      model: "github_copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6"
  - model_name: claude-haiku-4.5
    litellm_params:
      model: "github_copilot/claude-haiku-4.5"
general_settings:
  #store_model_in_db: true
litellm_settings:
  drop_params: true
  additional_drop_params: ["context_management"]
  callbacks:
    - prometheus
  model_list:
    timeout: 300
    stream_timeout: 30
  router_settings:
    timeout: 300

source_directories:
    - /mailbackup
repositories:
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_DEFAULT_DOMAIN}//opt/local/mailbackup
    label: onsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_OFFSITE_DOMAIN}//opt/backup/mailbackup
    label: offsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
ssh_command: ssh -i /home/user/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no
archive_name_format: mailbackup-{now}
